name: report_security_incident
description: report_security_incident: Open a security case for a lost, stolen, or potentially compromised company device. Returns a security case ID.

employee_id.description: The employee reporting the incident (e.g. EMP048271).

asset_tag.description: The asset tag of the affected device, which must be assigned to the caller (e.g. AST-LPT-284719).
